steps.content: Isomer detests memories.
They are omnipresent.
[Scene Transition] [Entering Memory]

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: Your paper on deep Mania resonance was praised by someone important. She wants you to join the Observation Hub. Specifically, the super-loop communication research group. I said yes. Consider this a great opportunity.

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: Start preparing the report for the group meeting. EDGE will be sending representatives. I'll deliver the presentation, and you'll back me up. Make sure we have more than enough content.

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: And don't make me lose face in front of those kids.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Who are you to take my spot? You've only published one paper. In terms of seniority, publications, and connections... it should've been me. I've been with the professor longer. I should have been the one to stay!

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Genius this, genius that... Just wait. One day, you'll get kicked down too. Just you wait...!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Those subjects were sooo boring! My dimensional singularity theory is way more exciting. Oh, there's also Mania matter conversion and energy utilization enhancement... That's right! Just like Prometheus who stole the fire!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: What? Even you don't get it? Oh well...

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I read all your papers. Finished them in one night. Oh, nothing impressive about that. I just breezed through them. I even drafted several improvement proposals. Have a look and see if you agree?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: What? You forgot? But these were your projects back before you graduated, right? Don't tell me you've gotten worse over the years.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: What on earth are you doing?! Isomer!
[Exit Flashback]
Isomer opens her eyes.

May 31, N.F. 116
3:01 AM
BR-003 High-Altitude Observation Hub
A black bipyramid appears before her. It's jet black, with no numbers marked on it, yet Isomer recognizes it instantly like a brainwave connection.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...It's you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Yes. I've come to collect what you promised during your interrogation.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I think we both know your collaboration with <color=#fb9259>them</color> will reward you with valuable intelligence. You serve only yourself, and you're quite good at it.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You've been sharing the progress of EDGE's dimensional technology with the Sillage Society. You must have gained quite a few things in return.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Of course. Is this what you want?
She raises her hand, summoning that chaos cube. This time, its contents shake a little, reflecting several ominous red lines.
A fine, wicker-like pattern, writhing within.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...Sage power. So you really did make contact with their fourth member.
Faint streams of light ripple across Schorl's jet-black surface, sweeping over Isomer's cube. It's running an in-depth analysis. Soon, the other person reaches a preliminary conclusion.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...It still retains some features of organic blood, but the purity of the Mania is high. Based on past cases, this type of "gift" either leads to death, or the birth of powerful Sinners.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: But your M-value remains within a safe range.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I spent six months analyzing it, integrating every anti-Mania theory the kids developed and testing them one by one. In the end, I managed to produce a new model. One that restricts Mania leakage while retaining part of the resonance and its ability to attack and defend.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: The underlying structure is still chaotic, but I've managed to bring it to a degree of stability.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Impressive results. Last time, when tracking the Underground Puppets and rescuing SHP-13, you used the power of this resonance to complete the inverse analysis as well, correct?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Yes. I've already deciphered the power code of one of the Underground Sages.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: There is only one problem. When this power was bestowed upon me, it had bound itself to my consciousness. None of the other EDGE "geniuses" can inherit it, steal it, or analyze it. In other words, I am the <color=#fb9259>sole</color> possessor of this technology. I am <color=#fb9259>irreplaceable</color>.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: So, what will you do now, ma'am?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: What will I do?
The bipyramid vibrates slightly, as if laughing.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I'll be proud of you, of course, Isomer. Your talent is undeniable.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Don't worry. I don't intend to make an issue of your relationship with Sillage, and I won't put you in a difficult position. I know you weren't the one who leaked BR-003's secrets.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I already know who the real culprit is. The <color=#fb9259>method</color>, <color=#fb9259>motive</color>, and <color=#fb9259>scope of damage</color> have all been assessed. Initial measures have been taken.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I just... didn't expect to discover more secrets within the little secrets of those kids.
Isomer's brow furrows instinctively.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: No need to concern yourself with that. We'll handle it. What you need to do is continue driving the research forward and deliver results. I'll see that you're rewarded accordingly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: For example, tell me, what is it that you want right now?
[Flashback Filter]

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...Me? I want to join the Ring Research Institute. If possible, I'd like to work under Professor Lambert. I want to crack the Mania problem and fight against the disasters on the front line.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I know I haven't achieved enough yet, but I still want to be a scientist.
[Exit Flashback]

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: What I want has never changed.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Give me that vacant EDGE seat. Authority is the only thing I want. As for the projects and data left behind by the former 07, I can't carry them on, nor do I care to.
She turns her gaze toward the black bipyramid.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Why don't you come? The amount of data is massive, and it involves highly classified material such as EDGE's core security intelligence. Even the most secure conventional transfer methods carry a risk of leaks or interception...

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I'd suggest you come in person.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...You want me to leave Paradeisos, come to a location that's already suffered enemy attacks, and expose myself to danger?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Yes. Weigh the risks, ma'am. If you don't retrieve this data, it remains in danger all the same.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Heh... Persuasive as always.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Who</color> are you working for right now, Isomer?
It rises slightly higher, hovering above. Scanning. Scrutinizing.
Isomer doesn't flinch. She approaches it.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I work for <color=#fb9259>myself</color>. But what about you? All your scheming, all your calculations... it's all because you covet Lemma's <color=#fb9259>unexpected breakthrough</color>, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: EDGE-02.
She speaks firmly, without a hint of hesitation, completely convinced by her own words.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Heh... What I covet? You'll find out eventually.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: For now, let's work together to get you what you want.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I accept your proposal. We'll meet at the Observation Hub on the agreed date, Isomer.

Central Library
May 31
The 3rd day after its closure
Celine Fabius reclines in a curved chair by the window.
Memories surge through rapidly in her chronicler mind, while her pen races across the page to record them as fast as possible.

In N.F. 33, Keylan died. The metropoles intensified their infiltration of DisCity, and what had begun as control and development gradually evolved into outright enslavement. In the long era of chaos that followed, rumors of "miracles" and "superhumans" spread throughout DisCity.
The chroniclers cannot determine whether these rumors were truly connected to the Underground, because both Sinners and Mania were taboo subjects during that period. Moreover, verifiable records of Sinners were not confined to DisCity, but scattered across a fractured world divided by the disasters.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: My thesis was submitted and published. I went to the academic forum. I practiced so many times, explained every aspect of my industrial history research, and even brought up the sensitive parts about Nirvana and West District. I had so many questions I wanted to ask.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: History's full of regrets and lessons, but there's plenty we can take away from it. Shouldn't we think about where to go next?

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: But... it seemed like... nobody cared...

According to the chroniclers' records, verifiable accounts of the Underground in the early history are exceedingly rare:
N.F. 68: DisCity's Independence Army seized a weapon (or technology) from the Underground at the site of a mysterious ritual. Within DisCity, this "technology" became known as "Reaper." It has since been confirmed that it was adapted from the Underground's advanced Mania sorcery.
N.F. 71: Remnants of the metropoles developed another weapon (or technology) of their own. Today, this technology is widely known as Fraser's "Aurum Secretum."
The metropoles eventually fell. Fraser's reacquisition of this technology bore direct ties to the Underground, thus retroactively linking this historical record to the organization.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: The audience wasn't really paying attention. Many people left halfway through... No one cared to ask questions. They were far more curious about gossip of the big families or Paradeisos conspiracy theories... There was a way larger crowd at the Phantom Entertainment promotional event.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Professor... I passed my thesis defense so easily. Was that because... the school didn't care either?

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I want to do something meaningful. I don't care about money or fame. I guess... I'm not even scared of getting attacked. It'd be kind of an honor, really. And I've... I've actually practiced how to run away quickly!

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: But the truth I worked so hard to restore is just going to rot away in some library archive. It seems like... it doesn't benefit the city in any way.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Did I get it all wrong? This thing I spent so much time researching, is it really what people need? Or is it just... a product of pedantry in the ivory tower... nothing but self-indulgent entertainment?

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Maybe I should try something else... find a more stable life? Go to the West District, join the Executive Committee, or just be a teacher...

By N.F. 84, the Mania crisis erupted on a massive scale, and the Underground was becoming increasingly active. It was during this period that the organization established the doctrine still recognized today: Mania Insurrectionism.
Over the decades that followed, they openly and covertly orchestrated more than a hundred documented Mania incidents. Though their activity waxed and waned, their objective never changed.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I'm sorry, Professor... You've put in so much work, and handed me such important material...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: You even said when I graduated, you wanted to pass your research on to me...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: But I don't know... if history still has any value in today's DisCity...

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Linda...
She calls out instinctively, then looks up, only to realize there's no one there.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: I'm afraid I can't pass it on for you... I'm sorry...
She finally stops, letting out a long sigh.

The origins of Rancor and Aurum Secretum have been confirmed. The dark web, on the other hand, emerged sometime after DisCity's independence, the exact time still unknown.

According to the 9th Agency's files, under the influence of a deserter from the Underground, BR-002 became the first documented artificially catalyzed Black Ring.

As for the Mania weapon rumored to have been created by the Laboratory of Parma, its underlying technology was long believed to have originated from Summer, but has since been confirmed that the true source was someone else. In N.F. 111, it was sold to Parma by Laplace of the Ring Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: They even call these things "technology." In that case...
Technological breakthroughs always reshape organizations and the way people operate. There must be traces hidden in the corners of history.
According to the newly acquired "rumors," even before N.F. 111... certain groups operating in West District had already...

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ...Found you.
Organizations affiliated with the Sillage Society... Transaction records for Mania weapon raw materials during N.F. 103 to 108...

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: ...What's this?
The latest technology leaked from the Ring Research Institute... The source is once again... the Institute's most renowned genius? Summer?
This transaction existed in the past, and it continues today. Another new technology. Another new agent. No, wait, that's not right. The timeline doesn't add up...
From outside the window comes the sharp noise of collisions. Shrill and relentless, like the cries of caged birds kept in the dark.
No, those are indeed bird cries. Celine looks up. A bird has flown into the library, only to be caught by the "net" she installed, shredded into numerous small squares.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Heh, well, that's...
Has she been a little too "aggressive"?
You are led into an unmarked, low-profile vehicle. The interior is completely covered and sealed. Not even the current time is displayed. It travels in almost complete silence.

The vehicle stops at last in a deserted clearing. You step out. The sky is utterly dark. You can barely make out some straight-lined silhouettes. You are made to walk along walls from time to time, unable to see the sky or hear any voices. Only your own footsteps echo back, as though you've entered a vast forest of derelict buildings.
You gently grip Schorl, letting it guide you forward. After some time, it stops. A door creaks open. You step into darkness once again. The door swings shut behind you. Then the lights come on.
[Scene Transition] Keylan Piano Room
You are brought into an empty room. The first thing you see is another bipyramid, hovering at the center, a ring suspended from its base.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: The former EDGE-07's Schorl. It is under investigation, along with her.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Lemma Herzfeld has been put under special confinement due to the sensitive nature of her position. I cannot bypass the rules to help you reach her. Her Schorl has also been formatted, and its "decorations" have been removed.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: However, Keylan-II is still connected to the brainwave communication channels of several researchers at the Hub. At your request, Chief, I can activate them using a special method.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Thank you.

options: Can you confirm this is all confidential?

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Lemma Herzfeld has lost her permissions, but you are not affected. You're still in charge of BR-003's security, so you have full authority to question the "suspects."

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Under special circumstances such as an unstable connection, the data I record can be stored locally for 48 hours before a <color=#fb9259>delayed upload</color>. During this period, your actions will not be synced to EDGE. Will that work?

options: That's more than enough. Connect me.

steps.content: [Communication]
You finally hear their voices.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Director Isomer hasn't come back. She seems very busy. Dinner was delivered quite late too, and no one really had much of an appetite...

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Lemma... was taken somewhere else. They said it's because her position is special, that she knows more sensitive information...
Sarah tries her best to update you on the situation, but still terrified, she struggles to form sentences.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: We're the only ones still locked in the quarters. They haven't told us when they'll let us go. They already took all our data and access, but no one explained the situation to us...
Enya has lost her usual energy. She's curled up, voice trembling.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: What will EDGE say... to Mom and Dad?

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Did we fail to meet the expectations? Was it because the verification experiment failed? Do they think we're too incompetent? But...

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Don't... don't say that! We're the best at what we do... We've accomplished so much. EDGE needs us.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: There's no way we'll...!
She finally breaks down and begins crying.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Sob... sob... What do we do? I... I'm so scared...
You remain silent. All you can do is listen to their muffled sobbing through the channel. You can't even hand them a tissue.
But then you hear the sound of someone drawing tissues from a box.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Yes, I'm here, Chief ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Have you kept the CDs? The Phanuel ones.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: They were all confiscated.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you remember how the songs go, don't you? You're all huge fans of Phanuel. You even went to her live events.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Mm... I know all of her songs.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's a star who carries your love and hope. An idol who works tirelessly to shine bright on stage and bring smiles to your faces.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even now, I'm sure she can give you strength.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: ...I understand what you mean. They're all friends I cherish. We're always together, whether we're working on our research or cheering for our favorite idol.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: I'll try my best to support everyone.

The other end of the line falls silent for a few seconds. Then, a soft breath. Without any accompaniment, Barrie taps the beat along the edge of the desk. In time with the monotonous noise from the ventilation duct, his lowered, trembling voice comes through.
At first, Barrie sings alone softly. When he reaches the chorus, Sarah is the first to join in with her hoarse voice. Then, another faint voice chimes in from the other side.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: ... Yes, I know how to sing Phanuel's songs.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Yes. These are songs that send people love and courage.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Yeah, I'm listening too. I know them too...
Their voices gradually harmonize. There's no music in the background. No loudspeakers. Only the youthful determination of these teenagers, dreaming of getting back on their feet once again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're going to be okay. It's not time to give up yet. None of us should give up.
Another channel comes through from the MBCC, brazenly cutting into your conversation. Or perhaps, someone let it in. You hear a familiar voice.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I've been waiting for you forever, Chief! I mean, what kind of protagonist shows up late all the time?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My bad. Good thing you're here, Summer. You've become so mature and reliable now.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Well, I need to make sure we're on the same page before taking action. And believe me when I say I've been holding myself back for a long time!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You took your time. You'd better have a plan ready, huh?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course. There are certain things I can't pull off without you. Please tell Lemma...

steps.speaker: Option
options: Pull yourself together, genius. People are still counting on you.

steps.content: [Scene Change]
The call ends.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Have you made all the necessary arrangements?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, leave the rest to me.
You look at your comms device. A new notification from the Observation Hub.
[Schedule Update] [Highly Classified] May 31, N.F. 116, 10:00 PM A top security level experiment will be conducted. Security measures are as follows...
Seeing your focused gaze, Schorl seems to have reached its conclusion.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: I'll arrange your return immediately. The vehicle will arrive in ten minutes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: One last question.
You turn back to look at the eerily empty and spacious room.
There is nothing in the room. Sharp edges cut straight through gray surfaces—or perhaps the walls used to be white, but after years of neglect, they now look gray in poor lighting.
It's completely empty, except for that piano. Pristine as if untouched by time, yet silent like a wordless sage.
...Staring at it, you could almost hear the notes, almost feel... a strange sense of familiarity from it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whose room is this?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That piano...

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Eventually, you will know. But not yet.
The black bipyramid drifts slowly, dim light flowing across its flawed surface. It illuminates the grayish white space, casts its glow upon you, and seems to bring forth the presence of a stranger.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: I am the assistance you need. Time is running short, Chief. Hurry up and do what you believe is right.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: A tsunami is coming. Before it crashes on the shore, you must find your path... the one you truly believe in.

The special confinement cell in the Observation Hub is too small even for a child. There has been no interrogation or announcement. There isn't even a clock in the room. In complete isolation, she feels forgotten by the world.
The only thing she was allowed to take with her was a copy of DisCity's Golden Age of Science. They made an exception, apparently. Since she got here, she's read it over and over again.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: In the future, I won't be the one who finishes this book. History will find its own echo.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Would you like to hear it?
Now, the book lies beside her tear-stained pillow.
Lemma has gotten out of bed.
In the locked cell, she sits upright, dips her finger in the tea she was given, and covers the walls with densely packed writing.
